22.name: Guest Bedroom Week (1)
22.overview: Scotty greets five very excited couples to coastal Mount Eliza and assigns them their first rooms: guest bedrooms. In this week-long house decider challenge, the team that produces the best guest bedroom gets first choice of the homes.

22.name: Guest Bedroom Week (2)
22.overview: The Blockheads work on their guest bedrooms and very quickly realise this Block is not going to be a walk in the park.

22.name: Guest Bedroom Week (3)
22.overview: The Blockheads struggle with the new site hours, and Dan makes it very clear that the rules will be enforced.

22.name: Guest Bedroom Week (4)
22.overview: Scotty and Shelley check in with the teams and raise the stakes with a money-making opportunity.

22.name: Guest Bedroom Reveal
22.overview: A body corporate meeting rattles one team, and the house decider winner takes home $10,000 for their guest bedroom.

22.name: Family Bathroom Week (1)
22.overview: Last night's explosive allegations in judging see one team go AWOL, meanwhile the remaining Blockheads get to choose their houses.

22.name: Family Bathroom Week (2)
22.overview: Scotty announces a $250,000 prize for the winner of this week's bathroom, revving up already competitive contestants.

22.name: Family Bathroom Week (3)
22.overview: The Blockheads compete in their first challenge of the season whilst struggling to complete their family bathrooms.

22.name: Family Bathroom Reveal
22.overview: Everyone pitches in to help one team, but will this be to their detriment? Find out who wins the $250,000 kitchen upgrade and $10,000 in a nail-biting finish.

22.name: Main Bedroom & Walk-In-Robe Week (1)
22.overview: The Blockheads are not happy after last night's judging; will a visit from some fan favourites help to cheer them up?

22.name: Main Bedroom & Walk-In-Robe Week (2)
22.overview: The competition is heating up as the Blockheads try to outdo each other with their creative main bedroom design ideas.

22.name: Main Bedroom & Walk-In-Robe Week (3)
22.overview: Tayla questions whether their house will sell if she doesn't change from her original plan and a new challenge provides lots of laughs.

22.name: Main Bedroom & Walk-In-Robe Reveal
22.overview: Scotty makes a surprise announcement that thrills The Blockheads. Plus, find out which team wins $10,000 for their bedroom and walk-in robe.

22.name: Main Ensuite Week (1)
22.overview: The teams are picking tiles and coming up with design ideas to make their main ensuites stand out from the rest.

22.name: Main Ensuite Week (2)
22.overview: The race is on, and the tradie war hits a dramatic fever pitch for main ensuite week. With the clock ticking, the desperate Blockheads are scrambling to avoid incomplete bathrooms.

22.name: Main Ensuite Week (3)
22.overview: The teams are having problems with their trades and budgets as they struggle to get their ensuites on track.

22.name: Main Ensuite Reveal
22.overview: Find out who takes home the $10,000 for their main ensuite.

22.name: Living, Dining & Alfresco Week (1)
22.overview: It's a huge week, as teams must deliver three massive areas: living and dining rooms and their alfresco terraces.

22.name: Living, Dining & Alfresco Week (2)
22.overview: Fireplaces cause headaches for the Blockheads, and Dan has some exciting news.

22.name: Living, Dining & Alfresco Week (3)
22.overview: The contestants compete in an action-packed challenge in the hope of winning some much-needed cash.

22.name: Living, Dining & Alfresco Reveal
22.overview: It's the biggest room and the most spectacular view in Block history. The teams reveal their massive living and dining spaces, triggering a high-stakes judging rollercoaster.

22.name: Guest Suite Week (1)
22.overview: The contestants are becoming more adventurous with the design choices for this week's guest suite, and there is a new foreperson in town.

22.name: Guest Suite Week (2)
22.overview: It's mishaps all round with tile mistakes, wacky wall colours and a delivery disaster that sets Wyatt off.

22.name: Guest Suite Week (3)
22.overview: With a high-stakes room reveal just hours away, Guest Suite Week pushes the weary Blockheads to an absolute breaking point, while a power struggle erupts between site managers.

22.name: Guest Suite Reveal
22.overview: At the season's halfway mark, Guest Suite Reveal delivers absolute mayhem! One disastrous room has the judges in fits of laughter, while another leaves them completely wowed.

22.name: Kitchen, Pantry, WC & Lift (1)
22.overview: The Blockheads start working on the heart of their homes, and there is friction in the share house.

22.name: Kitchen, Pantry, WC & Lift (2)
22.overview: The teams prepare their spaces for kitchen installations, and Block all-stars drop by to invite them to a tricky challenge.

22.name: Kitchen, Pantry, WC & Lift (3)
22.overview: Shelley helps Tayla with her styling, Sev gets good news, and there are 100,000 reasons to win Kitchen Week.

22.name: Kitchen, Pantry, WC & Lift Reveal
22.overview: Time is running out and the gloves come off for the season's biggest reveal yet! Tensions among the teams rise across the site before one standout space secures the $100,000 win.

22.name: Rumpus & Laundry (1)
22.overview: High Kitchen Week scores offer little reprieve as Rupmus and Laundry Week beings.  Bad blood boils over when a group community challenge forces bitter rivals to work side by side.

22.name: Rumpus & Laundry (2)
22.overview: As the charity challenge continues, teams struggle to divide their time. While everyone unites to deliver vital emergency housing, friction on-site fuels fresh personal rifts.

22.name: Rumpus & Laundry (3)
22.overview: A winning team is awarded $10,000 in a heartfelt challenge finish, but a frantic push to catch up on Rumpus and Laundry Week triggers an explosive fallout on the Block.

22.name: Rumpus & Laundry Reveal
22.overview: A winning team is awarded $10,000 in a heartfelt challenge finish, but a frantic push to catch up on Rumpus and Laundry Week triggers an explosive fallout on the Block.

22.name: Kids Room and Re-Do Room Week (1)
22.overview: In the biggest week yet, battling Blockheads clear site ruin for the upcoming Domain Buyers Jury Challenge, all while launching into the Kids Bedroom and facing their Re-do Room.

22.name: Kids Room and Re-Do Room Week (2)
22.overview: A massive prize is up for grabs as teams juggle their final interior spaces and a dazzling open house. But under the heavy workload, pots are stirred and site tensions simmer.

22.name: Kids Room and Re-Do Room Week (3)
22.overview: With a huge $50,000 prize and a glimpse at future auction success on the line, the crucial Domain Buyers Jury Challenge reveals which house has won over Mount Eliza buyers.

22.name: Kids Bedroom Reveal
22.overview: Double reveal day arrives as teams present their Kids Bedrooms alongside a critical Re-do Room. Hopes run high for redemption, but repeat mistakes bring harsh judging feedback.

22.name: Outdoor Terrace & Pool (1)
22.overview: The latest judging feedback leaves some teams feeling cheated and defeated. But there's no time to dwell as focus finally moves outside for Outdoor Terrace and Pool Week.

22.name: Outdoor Terrace & Pool (2)
22.overview: Special guest Hamish Blake hosts a wild athletics carnival after an emotional family reunion. Joy is short-lived as the daunting reality of Outdoor Terrace and Pool Week sets in.

22.name: Outdoor Terrace & Pool (3)
22.overview: As time slips away, teams are in real danger of not delivering their outdoor terraces and pools. Pressure reaches boiling point as endless setbacks strike from all directions.

22.name: Outdoor Terrace & Pool Reveal
22.overview: It's Outdoor Terrace and Pool reveal day and the teams are bringing big deck energy! Racing against the clock, duos must deliver or risk falling flat in front of the judges.

22.name: Backyard & Garage (1)
22.overview: As Backyard and Garage week kicks off, extra sharehouse tension spills onto the site. Severe budget blowouts force production intervention over one team's cash crisis.

22.name: Backyard & Garage (2)
22.overview: Teams are digging deep on site for Backyard and Garage week, but a fiery body corporate meeting to evict extra guests from the share house leaves the duos more divided than ever.

22.name: Backyard & Garage (3)
22.overview: Desperate for cash, teams enter full challenge mode to stay afloat for the final two weeks of competition. As backyard builds progress, fractured neighbourly fences begin mending.

22.name: Backyard & Garage Reveal
22.overview: The penultimate judging arrives with spectacular Backyard and Garage reveals. Proving all is not fair in competition, frustrated teams turn on one another over bended rules.

22.name: Frontyard & Facade (1)
22.overview: After a tightly contested judging, the final week begins! The Blockheads tackle Frontyard and Facades with everything they have left to win a massive $50,000 off their reserve.

22.name: Frontyard & Facade (2)
22.overview: Frontyards finally begin taking shape, but patience is running dangerously thin. While some teams give it their all, others feel the crunch of the competition taking its toll.

22.name: Front Yard & Facade (3)
22.overview: With the final reveal fast approaching, the Blockheads reflect on their journey while racing to finish their yards, and Scotty and Shelley hit the site for their final walkaround.

22.name: Front Yard & Facade Reveal
22.overview: The final reveal of Season 22 is here! The Blockheads present their Frontyards and Facades, making one last bid to take out the huge $50,000 reserve discount before Auction Day.

22.name: Grand Final / Auction
22.overview: Auction day is finally here, find out who wins The Block in 2026.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In the season that launched one of Australia's most beloved shows, four couples renovate four floors of an apartment block in Bondi.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Four couples renovate properties in Sydney's idyllic, world-famous suburb of Manly, to see who can take home the biggest profit come auction.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: four couples renovating rundown apartments in the upscale Sydney suburb of Vaucluse

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview:
The fourth season of The Block premiered on Monday, 20 June 2011 at 7:00 pm on the Nine Network. Host Scott Cam returned from the previous season, with Shelley Craft joining the series as "Challenge Master".

Unlike previous series, the fourth season was filmed in Melbourne rather than Sydney, with the four houses to be renovated located in the inner-city suburb of Richmond.

The season was ultimately won by Polly Porter and Warwick "Waz" Jones, who were the only couple to sell their property at auction.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview:
The fifth season of The Block premiered on Monday, 16 April 2012 at 7:00 pm on the Nine Network. Both host Scott Cam and "Challenge Master" Shelley Craft returned from the previous season.

Like the previous season, this season was filmed in Melbourne, with the four houses to be renovated located in the inner-city suburb of South Melbourne.

At first, this season wasn't to air in New Zealand, but has now been picked up by TV3. All four previous seasons have aired on Prime.

seasons.name: All Stars
seasons.overview:
The Block All Stars premiered on Monday, 4 February 2013 at 7:00 pm on the Nine Network. Both host Scott Cam and "Challenge Master" Shelley Craft returned from the previous season.

Production for the series relocated from Melbourne—which had hosted the prior two seasons—to its original location of Bondi in Sydney to celebrate the tenth anniversary of the show's first season.

seasons.overview: featured five couples, each from a different Australian state, renovating a high-rise apartment building in South Melbourne

seasons.name: Season 8

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: Five couples are tasked with renovating the notorious Gatwick Hotel into luxury apartments to be sold at public auction for profit and a life changing $100,000 prize.

seasons.name: Season 15
seasons.overview: Five ambitious couples transform the neglected Oslo Hotel in St Kilda into five top-end, three-storey homes. A renovation that's bigger, tougher and longer than ever.

seasons.name: Season 16
seasons.overview: Five period homes from the 1910s, 20s, 30s, 40s and 50s will be brought back to life by five eager new couples on a block of land in the heart of sunny and affluent Melbourne.

seasons.name: Season 17
seasons.overview:
Australia's favourite reno show is back and this year, young blood takes on Block legends in The Block Fans v Faves

You won't believe the twists, turns and surprises that are about to go down in this Melbourne cul-de-sac.

For starters, we've thrown out the plans and our BLOCKheads must design the entire layout from scratch!

It's Fans versus Faves.

seasons.name: Season 18
seasons.overview: Saddle up it's going to be a bumpy ride as five 'city-slicker' teams are dropped in country Victoria to renovate 500 square-metre houses on 10 acre pieces of land.

seasons.name: Season 19
seasons.overview: Located on Charming Street, the houses on The Block Season 19 were made in the 50s and are overdue for an update. Will our fresh-faced Blockheads be up to the challenge?

seasons.name: Block Island
seasons.overview: Get ready to celebrate two decades of design, drama, and dazzling renovations when The Block returns for an incredible 20th season.

seasons.name: Season 21
seasons.overview: Five Blockhead teams tasked with brand new builds, identical floorplans, midnight curfews and the opportunity to snag a new weekly $10,000 budgeting prize

seasons.name: Season 22
seasons.overview: The Block takes place in Mount Eliza on Victoria's Mornington Peninsula, featuring five duos renovating luxury two-storey homes with historic water views. Instead of living in the homes they’re building, or roughing it in the tents and caravans, all five teams will be bunking together under one roof.
